title: [V1 quantum audit tranche] Denominator-complete ORION-Q/QG/QN disposition and resource closure
body:
Parents: #1357, #1359

This issue binds the quantum/frontier audit to the complete open non-PR issue denominator acquired at a frozen current-main identity. It replaces title-only or regex-only closure with issue→PR→commit→artifact→theorem→resource→authority binding.

## Required final disposition per quantum/frontier issue

Exactly one of:

- `PROVEN`
- `FORMALLY_CHECKED`
- `COMPUTATIONALLY_GREEN_BOUNDED`
- `VALID_NEGATIVE_OR_BOUNDARY_RESULT`
- `BOUNDED_CONJECTURE`
- `COUNTEREXAMPLE`
- `ENGINEERING_CLOSED`
- `DUPLICATE_OR_SUBSUMED`
- `EXTERNAL_AUTHORITY_OR_ACCESS_BLOCKER`
- `LOCAL_REPAIR_SUCCESSOR_REQUIRED`
- `CANNOT_CHECK`

## Required binding

For each issue, bind current title/body/comments, linked PRs and merge commits, current-main paths, result artifacts and hashes, tests/checkers, assumptions, theorem/finite/empirical status, adverse evidence, transfer mapping, and remaining authority.

A commit or result file alone is not closure. Structural quantum transfer does not imply physical validity or quantum advantage. Every claimed gain requires source theorem, target representation map, held-out target-native consequence, negative twin, information-matched donor, and complete oracle/compiler/verification/sampling/recovery/hardware resource accounting.

## Common-core strategy

Cluster issues by shared mathematical object and close them through a common theorem, algorithm, certificate, or counterexample where justified. Administrative mass closure is forbidden; every issue retains its own estimand and disposition row.

## Execution boundary

`paper_authority_delta = NONE`. Local tractable checks must run now. Heavy compute, unavailable data, rights, hardware, independent custody, novelty, and independent review become prospectively frozen successor jobs or `CANNOT_CHECK`, never inferred success.

## Success terminal

`V1_QUANTUM_FRONTIER_AUDIT_CLOSED`

This does not grant physical-quantum validity, quantum advantage, novelty, publication acceptance, or ORION V1 freeze.
